source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_sep = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        first, second = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep+1:]
    else:
        col_sep = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
        first = [row[:col_sep] for row in grid]
        second = [row[col_sep+1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(v for row in first for v in row) & set(v for row in second for v in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == color and second[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(len(first[0]))] for r in range(len(first))]
'''
